positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Managed 0-1 projects across cross-functional teams to increase close
connection sharing between people
-Successfully increased teens / young adult engagement with data driven
analysis and spear heading projects to drive successful trends with teens.
-Data analysis to identify core flows that are not performant and provide
hypotheses on how to improve engagement. Resulting in successful uplift
in core engagement.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Led the development of multiple high-priority projects for the Facebook
app, which directly let to end user engagement and revenue growth
- Built and managed the Stories Tray on top of Facebook home, which is the
most important area of the app
- Successfully proposed and drove high impact projects such as Video
Autoplay - which required cross functional team development between
Networking, Video, Stories, Feed
- Innovated new ways to streamline data to allow video playback given
critical resources and memory

projects.title: Champions of league of legends
projects.description:
Over 1 million downloads and increasing each day!

Allows users to view information and updates for League of Legends. The app gives detailed information about each champion and allows the user to read the patch notes as well as any promotions that are going on.

projects.title: JomJom
projects.description: Created a social app that allows users to anonymously post and ask questions without revealing your identity. It is currently targeted to students from South Korea studying in various parts of the world who want to connect with others.
